name: deckit
description: Image-first decks with optional complex-flow screenshot pages, PPTX/PDF delivery, previews and downstream element reconstruction.

interface.longDescription: Version: 0.6.0. Deckit coordinates end-to-end image-first deck production from text, PDF, URL, or a topic seed: recommend a plan and reusable visual style, shape the argument, create storyboards and prompts, invoke official $imagegen to produce full-slide PNGs, package image-container PPTX or image-only PDF, generate standard previews, and review/audit the result. The extensible style library includes adaptive-default and notability-handwritten-cn, with stable IDs and preflight short codes. Runs live under the user's active working directory, preferably outputs/<run-name>. Explicit Deckit topic requests produce complete decks unless text-only or partial output is requested. After bitmap review, users may optionally choose Gorden Super PPT Skills (the externally installed GordenImage2PPTX conversion skill) or Microsoft 365 Copilot inside PowerPoint to reconstruct editable elements. Reconstruction is off by default, may cover selected pages, preserves the bitmap delivery, and stores derivatives separately. Gorden restores ordinary native text and movable image layers; Copilot can restore text and suitable simple shapes while complex artwork may remain independent images. If usable PowerPoint Copilot is unavailable, offer cancellation or Gorden without switching automatically. Check actual dependencies and record structural, visual, and edit/save/close/reopen acceptance separately. Baseline PPTX auditing remains exactly one full-slide picture per slide; native derivatives use a separate acceptance checklist. Version 0.6.0 adds a bundled Archify-based screenshot route only for selected complex workflow pages with exact branches, merges, retries or cross-role swimlanes. Simple flows and all ordinary slides still use official image generation. A complex page retains graph JSON and layout/browser receipts, is delivered as a 3200x1800 bitmap in the same one-picture-per-slide container, and may appear between generated pages. Requires Node.js 22+ and an existing Chrome/Edge/Chromium for those pages only. Native diagram-shape export is not implemented.
defaultPrompt: Turn this transcript into a complete image-first deck with generated full-slide images, PPTX packaging, and a preview image.
Explain this research topic as an image-first deck.
Make a complete image-first deck; first recommend a plan and ask whether to accept it, expand options, or add custom requirements.
